ctx.x: See, the two brothers and then Hamilton. They run the band, it‘s very good, very smooth and there‘s no problems. I haven‘t seen no problems in this band, and I‘ve been in this band since it first started. I was in this band from the first rehearsal. I was in Thad Jones and Mel Lewis‘s band since the first rehearsal. So, I‘ve been lucky that way, you know what I‘m saying.
